title: First real large transcript recovery + adversarial operational pilot

source_provenance.notes: Sprint 2 identifies first real large corpus as decisive gate

problem_or_opportunity: Synthetic/unit tests cannot prove that the recovery stack correctly reconstructs project partitions, persisted claims, chat-only material and the actual frontier in a long real copied conversation.
proposed_mechanism: Use the first genuinely pasted/exported long prior conversation as a production pilot: preserve exact source hash, run v1 extraction, reconcile with current persisted stores, audit every consequential claim, recover at least one chat-only artifact when present, transactionally persist accepted deltas, read back, reconstruct frontier and compare to independently verified current state.
expected_benefit: Provides real evidence about recovery precision, false promotion, context-loss reduction, tool-call cost, semantic partitioning and correct continuation.

hard_invariants: all material unknown/conflict dispositioned before completion

red_team_findings: A real pilot may reveal parser/semantic failures not visible in unit tests
Pilot completion cannot fabricate missing source portions
A successful recovery can still legitimately STOP on a Founder/human/provider gate
next_action: Execute on the first real large pasted prior-conversation corpus; record all defects/successes and feed results to Learning Ledger and SI-0008/SI-0009 dispositions.
notes: This is the empirical gate prioritized by Sprint 2 over further prompt inflation.
